name: Survival Workyard v3 exterior
review_note: Owner-directed compound (lodge, passage, hearth octagon, open court, dock) now carries laid ridge caps in a lighter stone, gable finials, a clay pot on the hearth flue and soffit boards; the fire ring at the pond edge and the chalk-banded lesson trees give the yard its lesson landmarks in the open. Palette 37 of 40, 21.1k tris, 110 prims.
verdict: meets the 9.0 gate - owner eyes-on still required
improve: The lean-to court roof still reads as one plain plane; the dock and pulley families keep per-part meshes; a dormer over the hearth room was not attempted on the octagon.
